The issuer exhibits severe financial distress, highlighted by an operating loss (EBIT of -$275M) and net loss (-$384M), alongside an extremely high leverage profile with total liabilities ($7,094M) comprising over 96% of total assets ($7,344M) and a razor-thin equity cushion of $249M. While current liquidity appears manageable with current assets exceeding current liabilities, the combination of negative profitability, high debt load, and weak solvency severely impairs debt coverage capacity, placing the company in deep speculative-grade territory.

DECISION: B-
